units: SAR million (sar_mn suffix), percent (pct), days, counts - exactly the frozen source units, unconverted

ews_corp_exposure.parquet.sql: SELECT * FROM _exposure ORDER BY reporting_quarter, facility_id

ews_corp_owner.parquet.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.*, 'ews-saudi-corporate-20q-v4e2' AS ews_release_id, 'v4-saudi-corporate-20q-v4' AS source_release_id, 'corp_borrower_quarter' AS source_table, 'borrower_quarter' AS ews_grain FROM corp_borrower_quarter b ) ORDER BY reporting_quarter, borrower_id

ews_series_portfolio.parquet.sql: SELECT reporting_quarter, ews_band, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT borrower_id) AS owners, SUM(ead_sar_mn) AS ead_sar_mn, SUM(ecl_sar_mn) AS ecl_sar_mn, SUM(CASE WHEN ews_band IN ('high', 'critical') THEN ead_sar_mn ELSE 0 END) AS severe_ead_sar_mn FROM _exposure GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

ews_series_segment.parquet.sql: SELECT reporting_quarter, sector, ews_band, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT borrower_id) AS owners, SUM(ead_sar_mn) AS ead_sar_mn, SUM(ecl_sar_mn) AS ecl_sar_mn, SUM(CASE WHEN ews_band IN ('high', 'critical') THEN ead_sar_mn ELSE 0 END) AS severe_ead_sar_mn FROM _exposure GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

ews_series_subsegment.parquet.grain: reporting_quarter x sector x sub_sector x ews_band
ews_series_subsegment.parquet.sql: SELECT reporting_quarter, sector, sub_sector, ews_band, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT borrower_id) AS owners, SUM(ead_sar_mn) AS ead_sar_mn, SUM(ecl_sar_mn) AS ecl_sar_mn, SUM(CASE WHEN ews_band IN ('high', 'critical') THEN ead_sar_mn ELSE 0 END) AS severe_ead_sar_mn FROM _exposure GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

ews_reason_period.parquet.sql: SELECT reporting_quarter, trim(reason) AS reason, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ead_sar_mn) AS ead_sar_mn FROM (SELECT reporting_quarter, ead_sar_mn, unnest(string_split(ews_reasons, '; ')) AS reason FROM _exposure WHERE ews_reasons <> '') WHERE trim(reason) <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

rule_status.score_expr: (CASE WHEN watchlist_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rating_notches_moved < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN covenant_breaches > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN dpd_days > 59 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN sicr_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN utilisation_pct >= 98 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN stage = 3 OR default_flag = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN external_dpd_days > 59 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN enquiries_q >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN inflow_trend_pct <= -30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN balance_buffer_months < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN returned_payments_q >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
rule_status.band_expr: CASE WHEN (ews_score) >= 10 THEN 'critical' WHEN (ews_score) >= 8 THEN 'high' WHEN (ews_score) >= 4 THEN 'moderate' WHEN (ews_score) >= 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'none' END

ews_retail_exposure.parquet.sql: SELECT * FROM _exposure ORDER BY reporting_month, account_id

ews_retail_owner.parquet.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cm.*, 'ews-saudi-retail-20m-v5e1' AS ews_release_id, 'v4-saudi-retail-20m-v5' AS source_release_id, 'retail_customer_month' AS source_table, 'customer_month' AS ews_grain FROM retail_customer_month cm ) ORDER BY reporting_month, customer_id

ews_series_portfolio.parquet.sql: SELECT reporting_month, ews_band, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS owners, SUM(ead_sar_mn) AS ead_sar_mn, SUM(ecl_sar_mn) AS ecl_sar_mn, SUM(CASE WHEN ews_band IN ('high', 'critical') THEN ead_sar_mn ELSE 0 END) AS severe_ead_sar_mn FROM _exposure GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

rule_status.score_expr: (CASE WHEN dpd_days > 0 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN score_band = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN (customer_score_band_previous = 'A' AND customer_score_band IN ('C', 'D', 'E')) OR (customer_score_band_previous = 'B' AND customer_score_band IN ('D', 'E')) OR (customer_score_band_previous = 'C' AND customer_score_band = 'E') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN utilisation_pct >= 85 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN payment_ratio_pct < 30 AND payment_ratio_change_3m <= -10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN bureau_score < 580 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN external_dpd_days > 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN enquiries_3m >= 5 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN salary_interruption_flag = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN balance_buffer_months < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN inflow_trend_pct <= -40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
rule_status.band_expr: CASE WHEN (ews_score) >= 7 THEN 'critical' WHEN (ews_score) >= 5 THEN 'high' WHEN (ews_score) >= 3 THEN 'moderate' WHEN (ews_score) >= 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'none' END
